title: Clean up activity indicator contracts after consolidating LIFT
outcome: Consolidated Codex+Claude review of frozen 57dd6a48 source diff: Codex no findings; Claude four Low cleanup items. (1) Strengthen MessageCard no-decoration tests to also reject the live message-activity-squares selector; old assistant-response-progress absence assertions catch restoration of the old component but not a differently named replacement, so calling them incapable of failure overstates the evidence. (2) Rename stale waiting-marker tests and remove state/data-activity plumbing from MessageActivityStatus/RequestActivityStatus or document an intentional styling hook; preserve visible status labels. (3) Give the independently rendered transcript slot its own CSS classes to remove coupling to global card styles, drop its unused data-activity attribute. (4) Check all assistant bubble descendants before removing the position: relative introduced for the deleted cursor. Keep fixed slot geometry, reduced-motion behavior, and single trailing decoration; targeted regression tests required. No demonstrated runtime defect; not a High/Medium blocker.
